package.description: Professional 2D CAD that opens, edits and saves DWG and DXF drawings.

en-US.description: Professional 2D CAD that opens, edits and saves DWG and DXF drawings.
en-US.longDescription: Nasjicad is a free 2D CAD program for Windows and macOS. It opens and saves native DWG and DXF drawings, draws with the usual tools (line, polyline, circle, arc, hatch, dimensions, blocks, layouts), and includes an agent that turns a written description into geometry in the drawing.
en-US.name: Nasjicad
